title: The Unwritten Route

completionEvidence.label: The convergent heart
completionEvidence.text: The completed PLUGH reconstruction resolves the collected inward traces into Medusa's living convergent structure. This is the mystery's epilogue evidence, not a prerequisite for itself.

clueStorage: Permanent commander journal records; zero cargo mass, retained after escape, ship trade, load and pack upgrade.
setPolicy: All commanders use the same current 64-clue base set. Every original campaign, repeatable family and tutorial contributes at its verified successful terminal, once per source. Future optional paid packs may add collectible evidence without becoming prerequisites for this base-game mystery.
plughAccess: The final required clue provides a normal navigation beacon for the local PLUGH station. Use existing PLUGH knowledge if already discovered. This reveals no Medusa location and does not enable XYZZY. Persist the revealed PLUGH entry position so it does not move on reload.
discoveryPolicy: No SH171 random, faction, wanted-list, ambient, scripted, misjump or XYZZY encounter before every required clue is decoded and all four trail objectives are completed in order. The only normal spawn is this quest's unique Medusa at the Ashor outer cradle. Redact its catalogue identity and design until the legitimate encounter.
destructionPolicy: Require actual destruction of the quest-instance Medusa credited to the player by the authoritative combat system, including the player's weapons. Targeting, culling, escape, NPC kills and generic SH171 kills do not grant the record. An uncredited loss permits a replacement encounter at the same unlocked checkpoint.
blueprintPolicy: Automatically preserve a zero-mass reconstruction record on the valid kill. Full rendering becomes visible, but every purchase/fabrication path remains locked until a later PLUGH AI confirmation.
fabricationPolicy: After reconstruction at any PLUGH station, permit ordinary paid Medusa purchase at PLUGH stations only. Retain the independent hull price and standard trade-in, capacity, fitting, confirmation and save rules. The quest grants fabrication access, not a free ship.
xyzzyPolicy: XYZZY convenience settings do not bypass this quest's discovery or fabrication gates. Isolated developer test fixtures may arrange state explicitly without changing a real commander's progress.
persistencePolicy: Save current clue receipts, decoder and ordered trail evidence, encounter identity, player kill record and fabrication entitlement in the current format. Restore normal play from those records; duplicate events cannot grant repeated rewards. Every new commander starts with no mystery progress or Medusa entitlement.

ship.visibility: SH171 only after legitimate quest encounter; other ships follow discovery and current mission visibility

artwork.visibilityPolicy: Do not preload or reveal future quest stage cards, clue glyphs, names or Medusa hull thumbnails through player-facing galleries before their authoritative visibility receipt. Authoring gallery is spoiler-marked.

clues.label: The missing instant
clues.text: The recovered timing standard contains an interval that none of the lane clocks measured. Inside that interval, a curved trace repeats eight times.
clues.awardDialog: VENN: There is one detail the inquiry could not explain: a curved trace in the timing standard, written between the clock ticks. I have copied it to your journal. PLUGH's AI may be able to read it.
clues.duplicateRule: Grant this source clue once per commander; repeat completions retain the same clue and never replace a missing source.
clues.branchRule: Every legitimate successful ending grants the same source clue; abandonment, failure, voided contracts and incidental sub-rewards do not.

trail.instruction: Take the complete clue collection to the AI at any PLUGH station and choose Decode the collected traces.
trail.dialog: PLUGH AI: These traces are different views of the same route. Together they describe a moving lens. Begin at Corur in Amber Divide, Galaxy 5. A dormant listener waits above the dark hemisphere. Scan it and bring the missing instant into phase.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: At Corur, scan the dormant listener above the planet's dark hemisphere.
trail.dialog: The listener unfolds a narrow arc of green points. Its timing matches the missing instant. The arc bends towards the ringed industrial world of Berilir.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: At Berilir, scan three marked echoes along the asteroid ring to complete the listener's pattern.
trail.dialog: Each echo answers one part of the silent voice. Together they trace an inward curve. The next bearing crosses the green world of Ranenor, where the extra lantern is reflected after local nightfall.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: At Ranenor, align the two orbital lanterns from the marked observation waypoint. Confirm each alignment when its reflected trace meets the inward mark.
trail.dialog: The two traces meet around an empty centre. The watermark now reads as a direction: the uncharted outer cradle at Ashor. Its entrance will answer only the complete pattern.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: Reach the marked outer-cradle waypoint at Ashor and transmit the complete decoded pattern.
trail.dialog: The cradle's green traces converge. Something has been following the same route from the other side. The AI identifies its returning signature: MEDUSA. Its propulsion organs open and turn towards your ship.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: Destroy the revealed Medusa. Your combat record must credit the destruction of this specific vessel.
trail.dialog: MEDUSA DESTROYED. Its final emission completes the missing structure in the inward mark. The reconstruction record is secure in your journal. Return to a PLUGH station so its AI can decode the fabrication pattern.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.

artwork.visibility: Only when this stage is unlocked; Medusa identity and full geometry remain hidden until its legitimate encounter

trail.instruction: Return to any PLUGH station and ask its AI to reconstruct the Medusa from the destruction record.
trail.dialog: PLUGH AI: The final emission completes the design. I can now grow the Medusa's hull and reproduce its systems. Fabrication access is available at PLUGH stations. Select Medusa in the shipyard to review the price and trade-in quote.
trail.visibility: Show only this unlocked instruction and completed history in the player journal; keep later instructions hidden.
